companies_tin_active_uidx.name: companies_tin_active_uidx
companies_tin_active_uidx.where: "companies"."tin" is not null and "companies"."deleted_at" is null

customer_invoices_posted_state_chk.name: customer_invoices_posted_state_chk
customer_invoices_posted_state_chk.value:
("customer_invoices"."status" = 'posted' and "customer_invoices"."posted_at" is not null)
        or ("customer_invoices"."status" <> 'posted' and "customer_invoices"."posted_at" is null)

customer_returns_posted_state_chk.name: customer_returns_posted_state_chk
customer_returns_posted_state_chk.value:
("customer_returns"."status" = 'posted' and "customer_returns"."posted_at" is not null and "customer_returns"."stock_movement_id" is not null)
        or ("customer_returns"."status" <> 'posted' and "customer_returns"."posted_at" is null)

deliveries_posted_state_chk.name: deliveries_posted_state_chk
deliveries_posted_state_chk.value:
("deliveries"."status" = 'posted' and "deliveries"."posted_at" is not null and "deliveries"."stock_movement_id" is not null)
        or ("deliveries"."status" <> 'posted' and "deliveries"."posted_at" is null)

employees_no_active_uidx.name: employees_no_active_uidx
employees_no_active_uidx.where: "employees"."employee_no" is not null and "employees"."deleted_at" is null

expenses_cancelled_state_chk.name: expenses_cancelled_state_chk
expenses_cancelled_state_chk.value:
("expenses"."status" = 'cancelled' and "expenses"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        or ("expenses"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "expenses"."cancelled_at" is null)

goods_receipts_posted_state_chk.name: goods_receipts_posted_state_chk
goods_receipts_posted_state_chk.value:
("goods_receipts"."status" = 'posted' and "goods_receipts"."posted_at" is not null)
        or ("goods_receipts"."status" <> 'posted' and "goods_receipts"."posted_at" is null)

partners_tin_active_uidx.name: partners_tin_active_uidx
partners_tin_active_uidx.where: "partners"."tin" is not null and "partners"."deleted_at" is null

payment_allocations_vendor_bill_active_u.name: payment_allocations_vendor_bill_active_uidx
payment_allocations_vendor_bill_active_u.where: "payment_allocations"."deleted_at" is null and "payment_allocations"."vendor_bill_id" is not null

payment_allocations_purchase_order_activ.name: payment_allocations_purchase_order_active_uidx
payment_allocations_purchase_order_activ.where: "payment_allocations"."deleted_at" is null and "payment_allocations"."purchase_order_id" is not null

payment_allocations_expense_active_uidx.name: payment_allocations_expense_active_uidx
payment_allocations_expense_active_uidx.where: "payment_allocations"."deleted_at" is null and "payment_allocations"."expense_id" is not null

payment_allocations_customer_invoice_act.name: payment_allocations_customer_invoice_active_uidx
payment_allocations_customer_invoice_act.where: "payment_allocations"."deleted_at" is null and "payment_allocations"."customer_invoice_id" is not null

payment_allocations_sales_order_active_u.name: payment_allocations_sales_order_active_uidx
payment_allocations_sales_order_active_u.where: "payment_allocations"."deleted_at" is null and "payment_allocations"."sales_order_id" is not null

payment_allocations_target_chk.name: payment_allocations_target_chk
payment_allocations_target_chk.value:
(case when "payment_allocations"."vendor_bill_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "payment_allocations"."purchase_order_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "payment_allocations"."expense_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "payment_allocations"."customer_invoice_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "payment_allocations"."sales_order_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        = 1

payments_posted_state_chk.name: payments_posted_state_chk
payments_posted_state_chk.value:
("payments"."status" = 'posted' and "payments"."posted_at" is not null and "payments"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("payments"."status" = 'cancelled' and "payments"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        or ("payments"."status" = 'draft' and "payments"."posted_at" is null and "payments"."cancelled_at" is null)

permissions_parts_active_uidx.name: permissions_parts_active_uidx
permissions_parts_active_uidx.where: "permissions"."application" is not null and "permissions"."feature" is not null and "permissions"."action" is not null and "permissions"."deleted_at" is null

product_compatibilities_date_range_chk.name: product_compatibilities_date_range_chk
product_compatibilities_date_range_chk.value: "product_compatibilities"."effective_to" is null or "product_compatibilities"."effective_from" is null or "product_compatibilities"."effective_to" >= "product_compatibilities"."effective_from"

sales_orders_confirmed_state_chk.name: sales_orders_confirmed_state_chk
sales_orders_confirmed_state_chk.value:
("sales_orders"."status" in ('confirmed', 'partially_delivered', 'delivered', 'invoiced') and "sales_orders"."confirmed_at" is not null)
        or ("sales_orders"."status" in ('quotation', 'cancelled') and "sales_orders"."confirmed_at" is null)

stock_counts_completed_range_chk.name: stock_counts_completed_range_chk
stock_counts_completed_range_chk.value: "stock_counts"."completed_at" is null or "stock_counts"."started_at" is null or "stock_counts"."completed_at" >= "stock_counts"."started_at"

stock_movements_location_direction_chk.name: stock_movements_location_direction_chk
stock_movements_location_direction_chk.value:
(
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('purchase_receipt', 'customer_return', 'opening_balance')
          and "stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null
        )
        or (
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('sale_issue', 'sale_delivery', 'supplier_return', 'scrap')
          and "stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null
        )
        or (
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'transfer'
          and "stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null
          and "stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null
          and "stock_movements"."from_location_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_location_id"
        )
        or "stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('adjustment', 'stock_count')

stock_movements_posted_state_chk.name: stock_movements_posted_state_chk
stock_movements_posted_state_chk.value:
("stock_movements"."status" = 'posted' and "stock_movements"."posted_at" is not null)
        or ("stock_movements"."status" <> 'posted' and "stock_movements"."posted_at" is null)

supplier_returns_posted_state_chk.name: supplier_returns_posted_state_chk
supplier_returns_posted_state_chk.value:
("supplier_returns"."status" = 'posted' and "supplier_returns"."posted_at" is not null and "supplier_returns"."stock_movement_id" is not null)
        or ("supplier_returns"."status" <> 'posted' and "supplier_returns"."posted_at" is null)

transfers_approved_state_chk.name: transfers_approved_state_chk
transfers_approved_state_chk.value:
("transfers"."status" in ('approved', 'dispatched', 'partially_received', 'received') and "transfers"."approved_at" is not null)
        or ("transfers"."status" = 'draft' and "transfers"."approved_at" is null)
        or ("transfers"."status" = 'cancelled')

transfers_dispatched_state_chk.name: transfers_dispatched_state_chk
transfers_dispatched_state_chk.value:
("transfers"."status" in ('dispatched', 'partially_received', 'received') and "transfers"."dispatched_at" is not null and "transfers"."dispatch_movement_id" is not null)
        or ("transfers"."status" in ('draft', 'approved', 'cancelled') and "transfers"."dispatched_at" is null)

users_email_active_uidx.name: users_email_active_uidx
users_email_active_uidx.where: "users"."email" is not null and "users"."deleted_at" is null

users_normalized_email_active_uidx.name: users_normalized_email_active_uidx
users_normalized_email_active_uidx.where: "users"."normalized_email" is not null and "users"."deleted_at" is null

vendor_bills_vendor_reference_active_uid.name: vendor_bills_vendor_reference_active_uidx
vendor_bills_vendor_reference_active_uid.where: "vendor_bills"."vendor_reference" is not null and "vendor_bills"."deleted_at" is null

vendor_bills_posted_state_chk.name: vendor_bills_posted_state_chk
vendor_bills_posted_state_chk.value:
("vendor_bills"."status" = 'posted' and "vendor_bills"."posted_at" is not null)
        or ("vendor_bills"."status" <> 'posted' and "vendor_bills"."posted_at" is null)
